notes.text:
NVIDIA has released a software update for the Omniverse Workstation Launcher to address a security issue that may lead to information disclosure.

To protect your system, download and apply the update for the Omniverse platform that you are using.
  • If you are using the licensed NVIDIA Omniverse Enterprise platform, download and apply the update from the NVIDIA Licensing Portal.
  • If you are using the free Omniverse platform, download and apply the update from the Omniverse Licensing and Pricing page.
